title: Meme Store
description: Browse the CNB meme store, preview full packs with pre-tagged semantics without cloning, install locally, and mount to multiple personas
installFromUrlDesc: Enter a Git repository URL (CNB / GitHub, etc.). Pre-tagged tags.json will be imported automatically if present.
packNamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use manifest.json or repo name
urlProtocolInvalid: URL must start with http(s)://, ssh:// or git@
searchPlaceholder: Search name, series, alias, or tags…
uninstallConfirm: Uninstall meme pack "{name}"? The pack and its store-only orphan images will be removed; memes added to other packs are kept.
mountDialogDesc: Select personas that should use "{name}". One pack can be mounted on multiple personas without overwriting their other packs.
mountEmpty: No personas available yet. Create one in Persona Config first.
noInstalledPacks: No meme packs installed from store yet
allPacksUpdated: All installed meme packs are up to date
adjustFilters: Try clearing your search or series filter
